serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Databricks Data + AI Platform is a unified, AI-powered platform built on a lakehouse architecture to provide an open, unified foundation for all data and governance, and is powered by a Data Intelligence Engine and Apache Spark™ that understands the uniqueness of your data. It enables organizations to process, govern, and extract actionable insights from all their data using both machine learning (ML) and generative AI, including large language models (LLMs). It unifies data engineering, analytics (SQL), and AI workloads, simplifying data management and accelerating analytics with features like automated extract, transform, and load (ETL), advanced query optimization, and AI-driven data cataloging. The platform's Data Intelligence Engine understands the unique semantics and usage patterns of an organization's data, offering natural language access, tailored recommendations, and robust governance and privacy controls. The offering is FedRAMP authorized at the Class C (formerly Moderate) impact level. See https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/security/privacy/fedramp#regional-support-for-features for the services included in this certification, by region.
